params.body:
A personal link that opens **Verkennen** without an office account, so people outside the office can browse the data at a workshop without being given a login to everything else.

## What a link opens

- `/verkennen`, its printout and its CSV. Nothing else: the day overview, insights, catalogue, crew and the worksheet pages still send a link visitor to the login. The office menu and the "fiche" links in the list are hidden for them, and a line says who the link was made for.
- It ends on its own date (1, 3, 7 or 14 days, until the end of that day) and the office can revoke it earlier. Revoking takes effect on the next request, also for somebody who has the page open: the next filter click answers "Deze link is verlopen of ingetrokken".
- Only a SHA-256 hash of the token is stored, so a copy of the database hands out no working links. The link is shown once, when it is made.

## How the office makes one

On Verkennen, signed in: **Delen met een link** opens a small panel. Fill in a name, choose how long, **Link maken**, copy, and mail it. The panel lists the active links with their end date and when each was last opened, with **Intrekken** next to each. One link per person, so each can be revoked on its own.

## How it is checked

- `OfficeOrExploreLink` replaces `auth` on the three Verkennen routes: an office login passes, otherwise the session must carry a link that is still good, looked up again on every request.
- Livewire's own update requests carry only middleware it is told to keep, so the middleware is registered as persistent in `AppServiceProvider`; without that, the filters would skip the check.
- `/verkennen/link/{token}` checks the token once, regenerates the session id, remembers the link in the session and records when it was opened. It is throttled to 20 a minute.
- Making and revoking links refuse anybody who is not signed in to the office, also when they call the Livewire methods directly.

Also fixed: a stray space before the comma between project and machine in the list ("Stabil , Rupskraan").

## Tests

`tests/Feature/ExploreLinkTest.php` (7): the link opens the page and both exports; it opens nothing else behind the login; a wrong, expired or revoked token is refused; revoking closes the page for somebody already on it; only the hash is stored; the office makes and revokes links on the page; a link visitor cannot make links. Full suite 207/207, pint clean. Checked by hand in a browser against a local database: opened as a link visitor, filtered, then revoked the link mid-session and the next click was refused.

After merge: the deploy runs `migrate` for the new `explore_links` table. Nothing else to run.
params.title: Verkennen: a personal link for people without an office account, with an end date and revoke
